title: mold_v0 pack.json
description: A mold_v0 pack (molds/mold_v0/MOLD.md, 'Pack and record-area contract'). Generated from src/pack-manifest.ts by npm run gen:pack-schema; do not edit.

refusal.viewer_launch.description: the refusal a viewer gets on launching (src/account-roles.ts accountRefusal); the shell adds who can change the role. The shell's own: Viewers can read reports, usage and transcripts but can't run {runs}.

refusal.viewer_edit.description: the refusal a viewer gets on changing anything (pack tools and routes, src/account-roles.ts accountRefusal); the shell adds who can change the role. The shell's own: Viewers can read but can't make changes.

admin_roles.support.description: what the Support platform role may do (src/admin-roles.ts roleHelp: /admin Admins, the admin MCP). The shell's own: Viewer, plus access requests, new accounts and invitations.

billing.needs_plan.description: /app/billing with no plan and no allowance: what is off until the account has a plan. The shell's own: Running {runs} needs a prepaid plan. Plans are invite-only for now: reply to your {product} contact, or write to us, and we'll set one up for your team.

plans.example_description.description: the description in New plan › JSON's starting point (/admin Spend › Plans). The shell's own: For teams using {product} every week

requests.research_alternatives.description: the label of the products a request's research brief compares the company with (/admin/requests). The shell's own: Alternatives

tips.sequence_field.description: the field naming which sequence a tip belongs to, in the Send a tip dock (/admin/accounts, /admin/journeys; the tips component, src/tips.ts). The shell's own: Series

journeys.one.description: what one of the step-by-step pipelines of the `journeys` component is called (/app Setup, `/app/journeys`, `/admin/journeys` and their refusals; src/journeys.ts). The shell's own: guide

journeys.many.description: the same, more than one. The shell's own: guides

usage.score.description: the score of the session engine's scored runs on /app/usage (its Recent runs chart). The shell's own: Score

usage.score_description.description: that chart's description. The shell's own: Score of the latest {runs} in this period.
